formalOriginalRun.scope: Lossless metadata projection of the single authorized actual TAP run. Directed boundary-isolation fixtures are not ordinary-play wins or feasibility evidence. No tests rerun and no replacement source-window measurements.

independentReview.scope: Independent event-interval integer thermal, timing and ledger review of six existing ordinary rounds; no Model/pilot/game execution.
method: Start from the authored recipes and ambient raw attempts. Event-free spans integrate temperature/age/progress directly for n ticks; they do not restart from observed temperatures.
Audit only recorded event boundaries: immediate input snapshots, simultaneous work/completions, all expiries, then terminal priority. Never choose new controls or simulate navigation repeat state.
Separate input delivery age/temperature from post-work expiry facts; preserve ready occupancy and derive stage, attempt and Q-accounting totals from verified permanent receipts.
limitations: Original raw hashes are provenance from the approved diagnostic-free projection index; private policies, predictors and author witnesses are not inspected.
Only present ordinary events are production coverage. Three mathematical fixtures validate the oracle only; they are not additional gameplay or production boundary tests.
TemperatureQ ledgers account for integer Q changes and archived attempts; they are not physical energy conservation.
No pause/retry/cancel/subtick/held-edge or post-terminal runtime claim is made. Exact expiry/closing delivery and simultaneous expiry coverage are reported rather than presumed.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryKitchenManagement.scope: Actual key edges and saved permanent stage/delivery receipts. Input receipts are immediate boundaries, not final interval states. Sparse two-second samples do not observe every temperature/work interval or every last-operation update; gaps are not reconstructed. Actual post-dispatch snapshots enforce keyboard consumption boundaries.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Actual saved automatic input changes and post-dispatch snapshots; the next playing decision advances beyond that tick, or a saved later-tick terminal state ends play. Recipe/menu snapshots remain separately identified.

uiDriverWindow.scope: Only the revised UI eight-check dependent sequence; prior shared ten checks remain unchanged. Original candidate/UI helper and pre-correction UI source remain preserved.

uiHistory.firstFailureEvidenceLimit: The failed pulse stores observations only on successful return; no R edge snapshots survived in this failed raw report. The precise R consumption state cannot be reconstructed or claimed.
uiHistory.firstScriptIdentityBasis: Original script preserved before correction; matches the pre-execution static review hash11e82 and the exact original UI source read by root. The first UI raw report itself does not contain a UI-driver start hash, so this is not claimed as a new retrospectively measured execution window.
uiHistory.scope: One failed UI dependency sequence and its corrected second run; no repeated shared checks and no capture failure is inferred.
